dedupe_keys.name: 国土数値情報 緊急輸送道路 roads bridges and tunnels series on g spatial information center

description: 国土数値情報(緊急輸送道路 [roads, bridges and tunnels] (series on G-spatial Information Center) is a series of datasets listed in G-spatial Information Center (G空間情報センター), Japan, an open data portal, published or maintained by 不動産・建設経済局. 全国の緊急輸送道路について、その路線形状データと属性データとして、緊急輸送道路の区分、道路種別、路線名称、出典資料名等をGISデータとして整備したものである。 作成年度：平成27年度 原典資料：各都道府県、政令指定都市「地域防災計画」、「緊急輸送道路ネットワーク計画図」等 国土地理院「地理院地図（標準地図）」 ※この地図の作成に当たっては... Coverage: Japan. The portal lists 47 near-identical datasets in this series (one per municipality, prefecture, year, month or site), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. The portal files it under the publisher 不動産・建設経済局. Its tags are 国交DPF. It offers 1 resource(s) in xyz. The portal shows 2024-10-05 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is the data owner's own terms of use (see the dataset page). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-gsi-portal.
